steps.title: Welkom bij Shillinq
steps.body: Kies eerst het land (juridische regio) en het organisatietype, daarna het rekeningschema-sjabloon, en maak de administratie aan. Tot slot kun je het rekeningschema en de referentiedata laden.

steps.title: Juridische regio (land)
steps.body: In welk land is deze organisatie juridisch gevestigd? Dit bepaalt de beschikbare organisatietypes en standaarden.

steps.title: Rekeningschema (RGS)
steps.body: Een rekeningschema (RGS – Referentie GrootboekSchema) is de gestandaardiseerde indeling van grootboekrekeningen waarop je balans en winst-en-verliesrekening zijn gebaseerd. Op basis van je organisatietype is alvast een passend sjabloon voorgesteld — je kunt dit aanpassen.

steps.title: Administratie aanmaken
steps.body: Maak de standaardadministratie aan. Hiermee wordt je organisatie als administratie in OpenRegister geregistreerd, zodat boekingen, facturen en rapportages eraan gekoppeld kunnen worden. Klik op 'Run' om de administratie aan te maken.

steps.title: Rekeningschema en referentiedata laden
steps.body: Laad het gekozen rekeningschema (grootboekrekeningen), de BTW-tarieven en — voor overheden — de BBV-taakvelden in de administratie. Dit kan even duren. Klik op 'Run' om te starten.

steps.title: Klaar
steps.body: Controleer je keuzes hieronder en rond de installatie af.

steps.title: Welcome to Shillinq
steps.body: Let's take a quick spin through your bookkeeping — we'll create a sales invoice together so you can see how the pieces fit. You'll add the record yourself.
Accounts Receivable is where your sales invoices live. Open it from the Bookkeeping menu to see what's outstanding.
steps.task: Click Accounts Receivable in the menu

steps.body: Add your first sales invoice — give it an invoice number, pick a customer and a due date, then save. You can add lines and post it later.
steps.task: Click New and save an invoice

steps.title: You're all set
steps.body: Nicely done — your first invoice is on the books. Head back to the Dashboard to track your finances, and reopen this tour anytime from the … menu.

config._note: Barcode detail — a barcode/SKU identifier bound to a product (type, format, UoM, default flag) for mobile scanning. Audit trail evidences barcode assignment changes.

Inventory Lot detail — a tracked batch/lot with manufacture/expiry dates, quantity and warehouse location (lot-batch-expiry control). Expiry alerts raised for this lot are listed; audit trail evidences lot status changes.
Expiry Alert detail — a raised alert that a lot is nearing or past its expiry date. Links to the originating lot and recipient; audit trail evidences resolution.

Inventory Valuation detail — a stock valuation snapshot (method, quantity, unit cost, total value, pending COGS) for a product/warehouse. Aggregation surfaces total valued stock; audit trail evidences revaluation.

Edit individual records to adjust stock manually; downstream StockMove postings update these values declaratively.

config._note: Stock Level detail — on-hand/available/reserved/in-transit quantities for a SKU at a location, with unit cost. Reorder rules governing this stock are listed; audit trail evidences movement and cost changes.

Stock records with a non-zero reservation. Lets the operator see at a glance which products are allocated to pending orders / production plans across all locations, sorted by largest reservation first.

config._note: Analytical cost centre detail — a costing dimension (code, budget, hierarchy) used to tag GL lines. GL postings list every movement carrying this cost centre; aggregation surfaces budget-vs-actual. Audit trail evidences budget and hierarchy changes.

Analytical cost object detail — a costing dimension (code, budget, hierarchy) used to tag GL lines. GL postings list every movement carrying this cost object; aggregation surfaces budget-vs-actual. Audit trail evidences budget and hierarchy changes.

Project detail — a project costing dimension with contract value, WIP and revenue-recognition (RJ 270). Assignments and WIP history are listed (existing related lists); segment P&L aggregation and audit trail evidence recognition method changes.

Allocation Rule detail — a cost-allocation rule (driver, cadence, source-account pattern, targets) that redistributes costs across dimensions. Audit trail evidences rule changes affecting cost apportionment.

config._note: EMU report account detail — an ESA/EMU-classified GL account contributing to the EMU balance (Wet Fido). Shows the account's EMU aggregation hash and ESA classifier; GL postings list the movements rolled up into the EMU figure. Audit trail evidences classification changes.

SBR/XBRL filing detail — an XBRL instance filed via Digipoort (entry point, taxonomy version, instance hash, receipt). The instance XML is available under Files; audit trail evidences submission and Digipoort acceptance/rejection.
KOR regime detail — the small-business VAT exemption status (opt-in/out dates, YTD revenue vs threshold, warning percentage). Audit trail evidences opt-in/out transitions.
Bank Connection detail — a linked bank account feed (PSD2/statement import). Imported bank statements from this connection are listed; audit trail evidences connection and mandate changes.

config._note: Matching Rule detail — a reconciliation rule (predicates, priority, confidence, auto-confirm) that auto-matches bank lines to journal entries. Audit trail evidences rule changes affecting auto-reconciliation.
Levy posting detail — a water-authority levy booking (heffing type, tariff, aanslag amount, EMU exclusion) with its GL transaction. Audit trail evidences the posting.
IV3 report detail — a quarterly IV3 submission to CBS (buckets, version, CBS message id). The XML attachment lives under Files; audit trail evidences submission and any correction.

GL Transaction detail — a balanced double-entry posting (debit=credit) with its source reference and journal link. GL lines list each debit/credit leg with account, dimensions and amount. Audit trail evidences posting/reversal for ledger integrity; source document (if any) under Files.

Journal Entry detail — a source journal (memorial/sales/purchase) that posts to the GL. Header shows type, cadence and approval state; the source document is available under Files and the resulting GL transaction is linked. Audit trail evidences the approval workflow.

config._note: GR participant detail — a member of a gemeenschappelijke regeling (name, type, cost share). Audit trail evidences membership and share changes affecting cost apportionment.
GR allocation key detail — the apportionment key (type, parameters, cost-cluster accounts) that distributes shared costs across GR participants. Audit trail evidences key changes.

General-ledger account detail — a single Chart-of-Accounts line (number, type, VAT/Vpb flags, BBV variant, retention). GL posting lines list every movement booked to this account; audit trail evidences master-data changes for ledger integrity.

Fixed Asset detail — a capitalised asset with commercial and fiscal book values and depreciation method (linear/degressive, VAMIL). The depreciation schedule lists each period's charge and GL posting; audit trail evidences impairment/disposal decisions. Aggregation surfaces book-value roll-forward.

config._note: Balance Sheet detail — the statement of financial position at the reporting date (Titel 9 rubrieken). Shows total assets/equity/liabilities and the balanced flag; aggregation reconciles activa=passiva. Audit trail evidences report generation and any manual overrides.

Trial Balance detail — a period snapshot proving debits=credits across all accounts. Trial-balance lines list per-account opening balance, movements and closing balance; aggregation surfaces total debits/credits and the balanced flag. Audit trail evidences the preparation sign-off.

Consolidation Group detail — the group definition (parent, member administrations, method, reporting currency/framework). Member entities list ownership and consolidation method per subsidiary; audit trail evidences membership and elimination-rule changes.

Consolidated Report detail — a group financial statement for a consolidation group and fiscal year, with eliminations applied. Intercompany transactions eliminated into this report are listed; aggregation surfaces consolidated totals. Audit trail evidences the consolidation run and review.

Inter-Company Transaction detail — a cross-administration booking flagged for elimination on consolidation. Shows counterparty entity, matched status and elimination rule; audit trail evidences manual overrides to the elimination decision.
Elimination Rule detail — a consolidation elimination rule (account pair, tolerance, type) applied to intercompany balances. Audit trail evidences rule changes affecting consolidated figures.
SiSa report detail — the Single-information Single-audit accountability report (findings by severity, compliance status, management letter link). Audit trail evidences the report and its assurance.
Compliance audit trail detail — a recorded finding/observation with severity and remediation status for a fiscal year. Audit trail evidences remediation progress.

Management letter detail — the auditor's letter (opinion, findings/observations summary, remediation recommendations) linked to a SiSa report. The letter document lives under Files; audit trail evidences issuance.

Audit document detail — a signed evidentiary document (type, signatory, signing reason/timestamp) linked to a GL transaction. The signed document lives under Files; audit trail (already enabled) evidences the signing and archiving lifecycle for retention compliance.
Retention period detail — a records-retention rule (category, retention years, legal basis, selectielijst code, disposition). Audit trail evidences rule changes governing archival and destruction.

config.description: Per-category tax summaries feeding the annual filing. Converted from the never-rendered type=report (no such page type is registered) to a plain index — the KPI dashboard variant needs a dedicated renderer first.

config._note: Tax Estimate detail — a YTD income-tax estimate snapshot (taxable income/expenses, estimated liability, withholding credits) driven by GL activity. Audit trail evidences the snapshot basis.
Tax Configuration detail — the tax-regime parameters (rates, allowances, filing deadline) effective for a fiscal year. Audit trail evidences parameter changes that drive tax estimates and returns.

fields.label: GL Account Category Mapping Rules
fields.help: Map GL account ranges (e.g. '4000-4099') or individual accounts to statutory tax categories.

config._note: Debtor master archetype — a customer that gets invoiced. Body leads with the schema-driven Data widget (legalName/tradeName, kvkNumber, vatID, iban, creditLimit, dunningPolicyRef — real CustomerMaster fields; the legacy page listed fabricated keys like customerNumber/name/tradingName/btwNumber/paymentTermDays/peppolEndpoint/phone that do not exist on this schema, fixed here) beside a Related panel. The AR position is the customer's whole reason to be here, so its invoices (ARInvoice filtered customerId=@objectId, rowRoute to ARInvoiceDetail) are the primary body list, with outstanding/open-invoice totals as summaryAggregates KPI chips. No comms leaves — CustomerMaster carries no email/talk linkedType beyond the plain email/telephone fields already in the Data widget. Audit trail evidences master-data changes (credit limit, IBAN) and stays in the sidebar per policy.

content.emptyText: No invoices yet for this customer.

config._note: Billing-document archetype — a receivable invoice sent to a customer. Body leads with the invoice's own fields (schema-driven Data widget: number, type, dates, EN 16931 party/tax fields, the folded dunning/writeOff summary groups, GL link) beside a Related panel for the customerId FK. Dunning history uses the real credit-control schema DunningRun (filter factuurId=@objectId, rowRoute to the existing DunningRunDetail page) — the legacy sidebar tab pointed at an orphaned DunningRecord schema filtered on a non-existent 'invoiceRef' field (no index/detail page ever existed for it); this is a pre-existing bug fixed here. sourceDocumentUri is a docudesk PDF reference, so a Files leaf replaces the old bespoke docudesk-attachment-viewer sidebar tab. Totals surface as summaryAggregates KPI chips (gross/due/paid, all sums over the invoice's own field via filter id=@objectId, the established self-value idiom) plus a dunning-run count. No comms leaves — an invoice is a billing document, not a conversation. Audit trail moves to the sidebar per policy. Note: the EN 16931 invoiceLines are an array EMBEDDED directly on ARInvoice (no separate register/schema, no FK) so they cannot be expressed as an object-list widget without fabricating a relation; wishlist for nc-vue below.

IP asset valuation detail — a valued intangible (WBSO/patent reference, valuation, innovation-box rate) for the afpelmethode. Profit allocations are listed (existing related list); audit trail evidences the valuation.

Innovation box election detail — the Wet Vpb art. 12b/12bg election (route, rate, forfaitair cap, qualifying profit). IP assets (afpelmethode) are listed (existing related list); innovatiebox administration aggregation and audit trail evidence the election.

config._note: R&D grant detail — a WBSO/innovation grant (scheme, requested/granted/determined amounts, indirect-25% horizon warning). Cost items are listed (existing related list); voortgangsrapportage aggregation and audit trail evidence the claim.

Cost item detail — a project/grant cost line (category, period, amount) supporting subsidy accountability. The supporting attachment lives under Files; audit trail evidences approval of the claimed cost.

Fiscal Year detail — a bookyear with its open/close state, opening and closing journals and reopen audit. Closing entries booked at year-end are listed; audit trail evidences the close and any reopen (period-close control).
Closing Entry detail — a period-end closing posting (type, amount, approval) linked to its GL transaction and fiscal year. Audit trail evidences the close approval (segregation of duties).
Rate Card Template detail — a reusable pricing template (tier structure, currency) versioned over time. Rate schedules derived from this template are listed; audit trail evidences template changes.
Rate Schedule detail — an effective-dated rate for a tier/unit with volume brackets. Resolved rate records that used this schedule are listed; audit trail evidences rate changes.
Rate Record detail — a resolved rate lookup (client/project/role/user, effective window, resolved rate/tier/unit) used to price time. Audit trail evidences the resolution.
Receipt detail — a single expense receipt (vendor, category, amount, OCR-extracted text) attached to an expense claim. The receipt image lives under Files; audit trail evidences the captured amount.

Expense Claim detail — an employee reimbursement claim aggregating receipts, per-diems and mileage into one approvable total. Related receipts and mileage entries list the underlying evidence; source receipt images live under Files. Audit trail evidences the approval workflow.
Mileage Entry detail — a business trip (from/to, distance, rate per km, vehicle) reimbursed via an expense claim. Audit trail evidences the recorded distance and rate.

BTW return detail — a periodic VAT return (rubrieken, verschuldigde omzetbelasting, voorbelasting, te betalen/teruggave) filed via Digipoort. The filed attachment lives under Files; audit trail evidences submission and acceptance.

config.description: REQ-VAT-010 + REQ-VAT-009: lists all settlement periods for the active administration with VAT totals broken down by rate. Aggregation source: VATAuditRecord.vatByPeriod (declarative x-openregister-aggregations).

REQ-VAT-010: per-period VAT reconciliation page. Shows the contributing invoices, line-by-line VATAuditRecord entries, the four VATGLAccounts balances for the period, and a 'Ready for Filing' checklist.
config._note: VAT Reconciliation detail — per-settlement-period VAT reconciliation (REQ-VAT-010). vatByPeriod aggregation surfaces net/VAT-per-rate/gross totals; sidebar tabs list contributing VAT audit records, the four VATGLAccounts balances and a ready-for-filing checklist. Audit trail evidences the reconciliation before the BTW-aangifte is filed.

items.label: VAT totals reconciled against bank statements
VATPayable21/9/6/0 GL balances match aggregation totals
All ServiceCategoryOverride exceptions reviewed for the period

config._note: ICP statement detail — the intra-community supplies listing (ICP-opgaaf) with per-counterparty lines filed via Digipoort. Audit trail evidences submission and any correction.

BTW correction detail — a supplementary VAT correction (suppletie) against an original return, with reason and adjustment amount. The supporting attachment lives under Files; audit trail evidences submission.
ZZP deduction detail — self-employed deductions (zelfstandigenaftrek, startersaftrek, MKB-winstvrijstelling) with the urencriterium qualification. Audit trail evidences the qualifying-hours basis.
BBV mapping detail — maps a GL account to its BBV taakveld/programma/paragraaf and IV3 bucket, with BCF compensability. Audit trail evidences classification changes affecting IV3 and BCF.
BCF claim detail — a BTW-compensatiefonds claim (quarter, compensable amount, breakdown, settlement). The supporting attachment lives under Files; audit trail evidences submission and settlement.
Reorder Rule detail — automatic replenishment policy for a stock item (reorder point, min/max, lead time, safety stock, optional auto-PO). Audit trail evidences threshold and auto-PO changes.

config._note: Cashflow Buffer Policy detail — the liquidity-buffer policy (fixed amount / months of fixed costs / custom formula) with alert thresholds. Audit trail evidences policy changes driving cashflow alerts.
config.description: Configure the cash buffer threshold and two-tier alert levels. REQ-CF-009.
Configure the multi-stage dunning ladder per customer group. REQ-CCD-001.

config._note: Dunning Ladder detail — a reminder escalation ladder (stages, channels, intervals) applied to a customer group. Customer overrides deviating from this ladder are listed; audit trail evidences ladder changes.

config.description: Per-customer exceptions on the base ladder (overheid extended terms, VIP skip stage 4/5). REQ-CCD-001.

config._note: Customer ladder override detail — a per-customer deviation from the base dunning ladder (paused/adjusted stages) with approval. Audit trail evidences the override approval.

config.description: Per-invoice per-stage execution log with evidence trail. Immutable post-execute. REQ-CCD-002.

config._note: Dunning Run detail — a single rendered dunning message dispatched for an invoice (stage, channel, amounts incl. statutory interest and collection cost). The rendered PDF is available under Files; audit trail evidences dispatch and delivery status.

config.description: BIK staffel + wettelijke rente per invoice (REQ-CCD-003).

config._note: Collection-cost calculation detail — statutory collection cost and interest (WIK/Besluit vergoeding buitengerechtelijke incassokosten) computed for an overdue invoice. Audit trail evidences the calculation basis.

config.description: Write-offs + BTW-teruggaaf voorbereiding per art. 29 OB. REQ-CCD-010.

config._note: Bad-debt write-off detail — an uncollectible invoice written off with the art. 29 OB VAT-refund declaration and GL posting. Supporting evidence lives under Files; audit trail evidences the write-off approval.

config.description: Purchase orders driving the 3-way match. Member 02 of bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way owns the controller + create flow.

config._note: Purchase Order detail — commitment document header (PO number, supplier, delivery, VAT totals). Order lines list the ordered goods/services; downstream goods receipts and 3-way match reconcile against this PO. Aggregation surfaces committed vs received value; audit trail evidences approval-chain changes for procurement compliance.

config.description: Goods Receipt Notes (GRN) — physical receipt against POs. Member 04 owns the capture flow.

config._note: Goods Receipt Note detail — records physically received quantities against one or more purchase orders. Receipt lines capture accepted/received/rejected quantities per PO line for 3-way match; audit trail evidences who received and inspected the goods (segregation of duties).

config.description: Read-only stub at slice-01. Member 05 owns UBL/Peppol/OCR ingestion.

config._note: Supplier Invoice detail — the payable document header (invoice number, supplier, VAT totals, UBL/PEPPOL source). The source UBL/OCR document is available under Files; the 3-way match reconciles this invoice against PO and goods receipt. Audit trail evidences posting and approval for AP compliance.

config.description: 3-way match outcomes. Member 06 owns the matching engine.

config._note: 3-way Match detail — reconciles a supplier invoice against its purchase order(s) and goods receipt(s). Shows match status, divergence details and the resolution action taken. Audit trail evidences the exception-handling decision (who resolved a mismatch and why) for AP internal control.

config.description: Filtered view of 3-way matches that need operator action (price/quantity/missing-GRN/missing-PO/fraud-alert exceptions). Member 08 owns the exception workflow.

Pre-filtered OR audit-log view showing only signing/approval lifecycle decisions for bookkeeping records per REQ-RAP-002. Source filter scopes results to lifecycle:*->signed transitions and updates on signedBy/approvedBy fields. Use this surface to answer 'who approved this document and when?' for accountantscontrole.

Pre-filtered OR audit-log view of records transitioning to marked-for-destruction or destruction-completed per REQ-RAP-003 / REQ-RAP-008. Serves as legal proof of Archiefwet-compliant disposal — every row links to the OR hash-chain entry certifying the transition. Use this surface for external auditor compliance verification.

Pre-filtered OR audit-log view of all mutations (create / update / delete / lifecycle) across bookkeeping records per REQ-RAP-004. The OR audit-log component renders the before/after snapshot inline; this surface is the bookkeeper's first stop for 'what changed in this record?' inquiries.

fields.label: From
fields.description: Inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the export window.

fields.label: To
fields.description: Inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the export window.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: all = every audit event in window; subject = events where caller is the actor (GDPR article 15 subject access).

config.description: Compliance Export API surface per REQ-RAP-005 — RBAC-scoped to the auditor group; non-auditor callers receive 403. Server filters PII fields (email, phone, address, displayName, firstName, lastName, birthDate, socialSecurityNumber, taxId, personId, ipAddress) before rendering CSV/XLSX/JSON. Every export request is itself recorded in the OR audit trail per REQ-RAP-005 scenario 3.

Nextcloud Activity app integration for decision lifecycle events (approval_requested / approval_approved / approval_rejected / document_signed / decision_made) per REQ-RAP-006. Events are emitted via IActivityManager::publish() from ApprovalRequest / ApprovalTask / SigningAuthority lifecycle transitions; the feed is permission-scoped by Nextcloud (callers see only events on objects they have read access to).

config._note: Deferred-tax provision detail — the net current/deferred tax position for a jurisdiction and period (DTA/DTL totals, balance-sheet presentation). Temporary differences and movements driving the position are listed; audit trail evidences recognition judgements.

Temporary difference detail — a book-vs-tax carrying-amount difference (deductible/taxable) with its reversal pattern and expected reversal year. Feeds the deferred-tax provision. Audit trail evidences the recognition and rate assumptions.

Deferred-tax movement detail — the period roll-forward of a deferred-tax balance (P&L, OCI, rate-change, translation, business-combination). Linked journal entries evidence the GL impact. Audit trail evidences the movement classification.

Tax loss carry-forward detail — an available fiscal loss with original/utilised/remaining amounts and expiry (Wet Vpb carry-forward). Recoverability rationale supports any recognised DTA. Audit trail evidences the recoverability assessment.

Effective-tax-rate reconciliation detail — reconciles statutory to effective tax expense (profit before tax, reconciling items, ETR). Aggregation surfaces the statutory-vs-effective bridge for the Titel-9 tax disclosure. Audit trail evidences the disclosure narrative.
Inventory GL posting configuration — maps inventory movements to GL accounts (inventory asset, COGS, GR/IR clearing, adjustment). Audit trail evidences posting-account changes that affect COGS.

Pension Plan detail — the plan definition (type, funding, provider, accrual rate, participant counts, regulatory framework). Actuarial valuations and pension movements are listed (existing related lists); audit trail evidences plan changes.

Actuarial Valuation detail — an IAS 19 valuation of a pension plan (DBO, plan assets, net liability, discount/salary/inflation assumptions, mortality table). Pension movements attributable to this valuation are listed; audit trail evidences actuary certification and approval.
WBSO Tag detail — an S&O project tag (code, RVO certification) used to mark research hours. Related activity codes are listed (existing related list); audit trail evidences tag changes.
WBSO Activity Code detail — an RVO S&O activity classification (allowed/disallowed) used to tag research hours. Audit trail evidences code changes that affect WBSO eligibility.

fields.label: Export Filters

config._note: Pension Disclosure Table detail — the assembled IAS 19 disclosure table for a plan and valuation date. Audit trail evidences approval of the disclosure content before it enters the annual report.

XBRL Taxonomy detail — a taxonomy version (publication/effective/expiry dates, status) used for SBR filings. Related mappings are listed (existing related list); audit trail evidences version lifecycle.
SBR Document detail — an SBR filing definition (taxonomy version, required fields, deadline, submission endpoint, auth method). Audit trail evidences filing-state transitions and validation errors.
XBRL Mapping detail — maps a source GL account to an XBRL concept for a taxonomy version. Audit trail evidences mapping changes that affect SBR filings.

config.description: Bank reconciliation sessions per REQ-REC-001. Each row is one account+period; click through to match, classify unresolved items, and produce a signed-off ReconciliationReport (REQ-REC-006).

config._note: Bank Reconciliation detail — the reconciliation of a bank account for a period (opening/closing balance, variance, match counts, sign-off). Matches, unresolved items and closure summary are shown (existing tabs); audit trail evidences preparer/verifier sign-off.

actions.label: Initiate (verify statement balance)
actions.description: REQ-REC-002 statement-balance verification runs server-side; non-zero variance surfaces a warning but does not block.

actions.label: Verify (sign off)
actions.description: REQ-REC-006 closure check: all matches must be classified, sign-off comment is required.

actions.label: Close
actions.description: Seal the reconciliation. After this, the session is immutable per REQ-REC-003.

actions.label: Revert for investigation
actions.description: Return the session to draft so the statement balance can be re-verified.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.description: Abandon a draft reconciliation. Audit-trailed but excluded from aggregations.

props.description: Matches recorded for this reconciliation session (REQ-REC-005). Filter to resolutionStatus=null to see unresolved items needing REQ-REC-004 classification.
Unresolved items for this session — bulk-classify via the resolution endpoint (REQ-REC-004).
REQ-REC-006: pre-close summary — matched count, unmatched GL/bank counts, total variance, and sign-off comment field. Verifier MUST supply sign-off before the verify transition.

bulkActions.label: Classify as Timing
bulkActions.description: Bulk REQ-REC-004 classification — operator supplies one reason for the whole selection.

config.description: REQ-REC-008: unresolved items across all open reconciliations, grouped by session. Bulk-classify multiple items at once with a shared reason.

REQ-REC-007: variance per closed reconciliation, derived from BankReconciliation records. Converted from the never-rendered type=report (no such page type is registered) to a plain index — the KPI/aggregation dashboard variant needs a dedicated renderer first.

config._note: Reconciliation Report detail — the sign-off summary of a bank reconciliation (matched count, variance, unmatched bank/GL). Audit trail evidences preparer and verifier sign-off (segregation of duties).
config.description: REQ-REC-001 + REQ-REC-006 sealed audit artifact. Immutable once created.

config._note: DBA assignment detail — a Wet DBA engagement intake (perspective, risk level/score, model-agreement link, WBA assessment). The evidence dossier and risk flags support the classification; audit trail evidences intake decisions.
DBA portfolio-risk detail — the aggregate DBA risk across active engagements (concentration, exclusive/long-term relationships, overall risk) at a peildatum. Audit trail evidences the risk snapshot.

DBA evidence dossier detail — the assembled evidence pack for an engagement (completeness score, missing items, retention term, archive/consent). Dossier documents live under Files; audit trail evidences archival.

DBA model agreement detail — a Belastingdienst model agreement (version, validity, essential clauses, publication URL, sha256). The agreement file lives under Files; audit trail evidences version changes.

ENSIA cycle detail — an annual ENSIA self-assessment cycle (year, deadlines, accountability domains, process owner). Evaluation questions and findings for this cycle are listed; the declaration file lives under Files. Audit trail evidences status transitions.

ENSIA evaluation question detail — a single self-assessment question (norm level, answer, maturity score, evidence, peer review). Evidence documents live under Files; audit trail evidences the peer-review workflow.
ENSIA finding detail — a risk/gap raised during the self-assessment (type, impact/likelihood, mitigation action, target date). Audit trail evidences remediation progress.

config.description: Read-only ENSIA audit-trail view for external IT auditors per REQ-ENSIA-008. Shows every create/update/delete/lifecycle event across ENSIAJaarcyclus + Evaluatievraag + Bevinding with before/after diff rendering. Post-peer-review edits carry a `reden` field enforced by ENSIAValidationGuard.

widgets.title: Generate college verklaring (DOCX)
widgets.description: Renders a VNG-template Word document for college sign-off (REQ-ENSIA-006). The active ENSIA cyclus MUST be in college-akkoord status. Output is a downloadable DOCX archived on cyclus.verklaringFile via docudesk.

widgets.title: Export ENSIA-portal XML
widgets.description: Renders an ENSIA-XSD-compliant XML payload for upload to the landelijke ENSIA-portal (REQ-ENSIA-007). The active ENSIA cyclus MUST be in college-akkoord with a signed verklaringFile.

config._note: Grant detail — a subsidy (direction, scheme/article, requested/granted/determined/paid/reclaimed amounts, award decisions). Repayment instalments are listed; award-decision documents (beschikking) are linked as fields and under Files. Audit trail evidences state transitions.
